1 Chat Checking Inventory Levels from Database

The chatbot can access real inventory levels from the SQLite database. When a customer asks about product availability (e.g., "How many large hoodies in stock?"), the agent queries the database and responds with accurate stock numbers for each size.

The chat widget is easily accessible with the prominent red button. Customer can ask inventory questions directly in the chat panel.

2 Dynamic Search Result Cards Appear After Category Query

When customers search for product categories (e.g., "hoodies"), the app displays dynamic product cards in real-time with images, names, prices, and descriptions. Results update instantly as the user interacts with the search bar.

Products page showing the grid of product cards. Each displays image, name, price, and description. Search bar filters results in real-time.

3 Problem 9 Usability: Size Selector with Real Inventory

When viewing a product detail page, customers see an interactive size selector displaying all available sizes with real-time inventory counts. Each size button shows the quantity in stock (e.g., "S (5 in stock)"). Out-of-stock sizes are disabled, preventing invalid selections.

Size selector on product detail page showing all available sizes with inventory counts (e.g., "S (5 in stock)", "M (5 in stock)", "L (8 in stock)"). Interactive buttons with premium styling and hover effects.
